newsitem.title: USA: US in midst of sustained economic expansion - Kantor.
newsitem.headline: US in midst of sustained economic expansion - Kantor.

text.p: The United States is in the midst of a balanced, sustained expansion, U.S. Commerce Secretary Mickey Kantor told reporters on Wednesday.
His department reported earlier that economic growth slowed to a 2.2 percent annualized pace in the third quarter from 4.7 percent in the second.
Kantor said he thought the economy was accelerating again and the expansion should continue in the months ahead.
The Commerce Secretary described the economy as a "balanced sustained economic expansion that's delivering the goods for the American people."
